biotools.summary: NiCo is a computational framework that integrates single-cell resolution spatial transcriptomics with matched single-cell RNA-sequencing data to infer the influence of the spatial niche on the cell state.  It identifies extrinsic drivers of cell state modulation by niche covariation analysis.
